prompt.project_info: Create a bright high-end smartphone-style portrait of two approved adult women seated together on a white leather sectional in an upscale lounge.
prompt.main_subject: Two approved adult women seated naturally together. Left: sleek dark high ponytail, polished makeup, calm expression looking at an orange smartphone, structured red fitted top, tailored lower garment, patterned black tights and pointed heels. Right: light red hair in a neat low bun, refined makeup, friendly smile, red halter-style fitted dress, sheer black tights and pointed heels. A yellow handbag rests beside them.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 4:5 medium full-body framing, both women seated close on a white leather sectional, legs relaxed and naturally overlapping, smartphone in left hand, yellow handbag visible, white walls, warm wood, plant, coffee table, sheer curtains, greenery outside, and existing neon wall sign.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused daylight through sheer curtains with warm ambient fill, gentle highlights on red fabrics and skin, clean modern luxury daytime mood.
prompt.technical_specs: High-end smartphone lifestyle photography, 4:5, natural perspective, moderate depth of field, realistic skin/fabric/leather, accurate hands, subtle grain, preserve existing sign only when requested.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic 4:5 high-end smartphone-style portrait of two approved adult women seated naturally together on a white leather sectional in a bright modern upscale lounge. The left woman has a sleek dark high ponytail, polished makeup, calm expression looking at an orange smartphone, a structured red fitted top, tailored lower garment, patterned black tights, and pointed heels. The right woman has light red hair in a neat low bun, refined makeup, friendly confident smile, a red halter-style fitted dress, sheer black tights, and pointed heels. Their legs are relaxed and naturally overlapped; a yellow handbag rests beside them. Include white walls, warm wood, potted plants, light wood coffee table, sheer curtains, greenery outside, and the existing neon wall sign only if typography is intentionally retained. Use soft diffused daylight, warm ambient fill, gentle fabric highlights, natural phone perspective, moderate depth, realistic texture, and subtle grain.
